messages:
Anya R: quick note from the usability session — the left filter rail animation in Model Catalog is causing a11y issues. focus ring disappears briefly and VoiceOver doesn't announce the expanded region.
Matt J: which animation? the slide+fade on the collapsed rail?
Anya R: yep. motion feels heavy and the focus jump is the main problem.
Jamie (prod UX): we added that to make the UI feel lighter but agree it breaks keyboard/VO flow. can we respect prefers-reduced-motion and reduce the animation?
Kevin - Eng: yes. we'll change CSS to disable transition when prefers-reduced-motion is set. also we'll make sure the focus outline stays visible during the expand.
Lisa - PM: also a small copy nit: when the version pin modal is open the filter button labeled "Show filters" is confusing. proposing "Open filters" instead.
Anya R: good call. another issue: performance badges in the compare table shift when the rail toggles. the reflow looks buggy.
Matt J: simple fix: reserve a min-width for badges so they don't move when content width changes.
Jamie (prod UX): and accessibility for version pinning: currently only the pin icon changes. add an aria-live status update like "Version pinned" so screen readers get clear feedback.
Kevin - Eng: will add an aria-live region and include a small JS update to set innerText on pin action.
designbot: lint: color-contrast-fail on .filter-rail-bg (ratio 3.8:1). suggest darker background or stronger text weight.
Anya R: noted 12; we'll update palette and focus colors.
Lisa - PM: prioritization: reduced-motion + aria-live this sprint. copy + badge spacing next sprint unless someone can do quick CSS patch.
Kevin - Eng: I can do reduced-motion and aria-live in one PR and include a fallback for older browsers.
Matt J: I'll change copy to "Open filters" and add a tooltip showing shortcut. I'll also push translation keys.
Jamie (prod UX): I'll add a short mock and accessibility checklist to the design review doc and attach before/after gifs.
Anya R: action items: 1) honor prefers-reduced-motion on filter toggle, 2) preserve focus ring on expand, 3) add aria-live for pin actions, 4) reserve badge width to avoid reflow, 5) change label to "Open filters".
Kevin - Eng: ping me for VO test account if you want to repro.
Lisa - PM: set PR label "opt-in a11y" and assign to Jamie for UX review. :thumbsup:
